title: GreenGateway Configuration Bundle Manifest
description: The bundle.yaml manifest of a greengateway.dev/v1alpha1 configuration bundle: a flat directory holding this manifest, one deployment document, and the policy and tools documents the manifest pins by SHA-256. Validate the manifest's JSON value; the YAML it is written in must also be in the safe subset documented in docs/configuration-bundles.md. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: the gateway's reader is authoritative and additionally checks the file layout, digests, duplicate references, and the referenced documents. A SHA-256 pin is integrity metadata, not authenticity.

apiVersion.description: Exact document version. No other version, prefix, or spelling is accepted.

name.description: A lowercase DNS label, as Kubernetes object names use.

deployment.description: The GatewayDeployment document, written as YAML (.yaml) or JSON (.json).

resources.description: Control-plane resources. Each stays its own document under its own schema and production validator; the bundle only pins it.

connections.description: Connections are managed by the gateway's Connections store in this document version and are never bundle content.

fileName.description: A portable bundle file name: lowercase, at most 63 bytes, not ending in a dot, and not a Windows device name. It can name neither a path nor an alternate data stream.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the referenced file's exact bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

oneOf.description: The bundle is the policy's only writer.

schema_version.description: Must equal the referenced document's schema_version exactly.

oneOf.description: The gateway's existing policy store is the writer.
The bundle is the tool definitions' only writer.

schema_version.description: Must equal the referenced document's schema_version exactly.

oneOf.description: The gateway's existing tools store is the writer.
